title: RoboHub feed snapshot, schema 1
description: One feed's snapshot as robohub-feed publishes it (FEED-0003): labels, values, units and times, and nothing else. No application, project, node or source identifier, address or token is allowed anywhere in it; additionalProperties is false at every level so a new member is a new schema.

id.description: The feed's id: at least 16 random lowercase hexadecimal characters, also the snapshot's file name.

refresh.description: The feed's refresh interval in seconds; a widget fetches the snapshot again after it.

time.description: A UTC time in ISO 8601, to the second.

value.description: A reading: a number, a string for a word state such as "on", or null before the first reading.

key.description: The item's position in the feed, i1 for the first: never the source it reads.

at.description: When the reading was taken; null before the first reading.

stale.description: True when the reading is older than three refresh intervals or 5 minutes, whichever is longer, or its source could not be read at the last refresh (FEED-0004).

history.description: For an item with a history window: [time, value] pairs, oldest first, at most 96.
